positions.title: Lead Developer
positions.description:
As a mixed lead and full stack engineer, I focused on keeping the team on track
while picking up some of the more challenging projects.

- Adding support for HTML clipboard data converted into bespoke document format and styling
- Correctly ensuring mutability and safe updates of legal documents
- Introduced intuitive fluid interfaces to improve readability and ease of testing asynchronous messages
- Continuous focus on improvement of work culture
- Mentoring co-workers and guiding junior developers
- Set up and maintained local development through Docker Compose
- Created a proof of concept for adding drag & drop support to bespoke document structures in the contract editor
- Performance profiling and speed improvements of PDF document parsing and document importing

With a keen focus on detail and proper preparation, even with tight deadlines,
the quality and correctness of legal documents could be guaranteed.
